x: (Mention should here be made of an incident before the race when Syd Roberts met with a street accident just before meeting Jack Bidgood and Co. at Chelsea.

Other speakers, Syd Roberts, who proposed the toast of the "Guests," followed by Ernie Clynes and the new President of the R.W.A., E. Kennell, all paid tribute to the ladies, rather diplomatically, I thought.
Syd Roberts then proposed Jack Bidgood for Life Membership and in seconding him, Jimmy Bellchamber gave a brief résumé of Jack's athletic career.
…d continued throughout the race giving encouragement and help. At Slough, Belgrave had a feeding station well manned by Syd. Roberts, Jack Rutland, George Checkley, Fred Rickards and Frank Thomson.…

The journey home was a merry one and en route, other "Garnets" were recalled from Harry Evans in 1907 to Syd Roberts and Doub in 1939. Opinions on the merits of the present year's team as compared to 1939 were very varied.
